title: File control: READ SET and STARTBR / READNEXT / READPREV SET over a seeded KSDS; NOTFND (RESP2 80) and ENDFILE (RESP2 90)

scenarios.summary: READ SET of K030 (NORMAL), of the absent K035 (NOTFND RESP2 80) and of the last record K050
STARTBR GTEQ of the absent K015 positions on K020; READNEXT SET returns K020..K050 (RIDFLD updated each time), then ENDFILE RESP2 90; ENDBR
STARTBR GTEQ of K040; READPREV SET returns K040..K010 (RIDFLD updated each time), then ENDFILE RESP2 90; ENDBR
STARTBR GTEQ past the last key and STARTBR EQUAL of an absent key are NOTFND RESP2 80; STARTBR EQUAL of K030, READNEXT SET returns it, ENDBR
